summary: Our team developed a moon rescue game where players travel through outer space to save the Moon from danger. The game allows players to explore space, complete challenges, and learn about the importance of protecting the Moon. We created this game to make learning about space fun and exciting. It also helps players understand how important the Moon is to Earth. Our project encourages creativity, problem-solving, and teamwork. We hope our game inspires people to learn more about space exploration and how we can protect the Moon for future generations. Saving the Moon is our mission!
details: Moon Explorer is an educational exploration game created using Roblox Studio. Players take on the role of astronauts and explore a virtual Moon filled with craters, rocks, and interesting locations. They can collect Moon rocks, travel between different areas, and discover features of the lunar surface. The game is designed to make learning about the Moon more fun, interactive, and engaging. Through this project, we hope to inspire young people to develop an interest in astronomy, science, and space exploration while encouraging curiosity about the universe.
